question: Approve DRC-4591 as delivered: the three-tier caveat rule with the long form behind redraw-safe disclosure?

artifacts.summary: GO. All eight criteria have live verifiers passing at the merged head, and both interactive criteria were settled by a live drive rather than reported unattempted. Three test-side blockers were found and fixed, none with a shipped defect behind it: AC-7's verifier did not reach the Console surface this issue introduced and was replaced with a derived sweep over every web JS file, falsified by planting a docs href in three separate bundle files; AC-3's own empty-body falsifier passed, and the closing assertion had to be tab-wide rather than aimed at the disclosure body, because the reachable arm is the no-summary path; and the implementer's own audit found four universal-worded criteria on enumerated verifiers, of which this issue's AC-1 and AC-4 were widened and AC-7's wording narrowed to state which half is enumerated.
